pages.title: Alpaca
pages.text: The alpaca ($(o)Vicugna pacos$()) is a domesticated South American camelid, bred from the wild vicuña in the Andes thousands of years ago.$(br2)It is smaller than the llama and is raised mainly for its soft, warm fleece rather than as a pack animal.$(br2)Alpacas live in herds and come in two breeds: the huacaya, with dense crimped fleece, and the suri, with long silky locks.
